payload.name: lithium (liquid, 800 K)
payload.structure_source: bcc Li supercell (a=3.51 A) melted in MD
payload.rationale: Premise check: Li melts at ~454 K and boils at ~1615 K, so 800 K is a stable liquid at 1 bar. Self-diffusion of a simple liquid metal is well defined and can be measured with equilibrium MD via the Einstein MSD relation over tens of ps with hundreds to ~1000 atoms. The experimental NMR reference is Murday & Cotts, J. Chem. Phys. 48, 4938 (1968).

_fulfilled_need.query: Compute the self-diffusion coefficient of liquid lithium at 800 K.

summary: candidate lithium (liquid, 800 K) (alkali metal, trust tier)
